purpose: Replace unsupported physical-laboratory scale assumptions with a useful purely computational successor: persistent event import and derived-view construction under retry and interruption.
scope: Synthetic, nonfinancial local SQLite data only. No live customer or operating-account mutation.
constructor: Developer-written ordinary SQLite transaction/unique-event mechanism. No model API and no claimed new algorithm.
outputs: deterministic CSV with source and output hashes
acceptance: Validate actual persisted rows, unique identities, exact integer totals and atomic rollback with a separate reference computation plus actual SQLite queries. Count/refuse conflicts and malformed input; successful status alone is insufficient.
comparators: Strong ordinary transactional SQL with equal input/content. Retain it if a proposed construction ties; do not weaken baseline to blind append.
observations: Declared fixtures and fault boundary only. No hidden future draws or buyer reservation values.
primary_metric: Exact accepted outputs and preservation of pre-failure durable state, including largest real artifact. Any false acceptance rejects the construction.
costs: Measure wall time, CPU, SQLite version, output bytes and row counts. Construction/inference billing and customer economics remain unknown and cannot be counted as zero or booked as profit.
financial_boundary: No new capital or balances. Original078 authorities are currently unavailable; native funded successor and commercial scale remain unexecuted pending genuine account access and source-compatible admission.
stopping: Exactly eight cases once after source freeze; retain every failure. Fix implementation defects only as separately labelled revisions. No seed search or outcome replacement.
decision: A correct artifact permits a later funded offer/admission test; failure stops this implementation. Neither result establishes US$3B, market adoption or discovery advantage.
